text: US stocks slipped Friday, led by a second straight drop in tech. The S&P 500 fell 0.4% to 7,562, the Nasdaq fell 0.9% and the Dow edged up 0.1%. Nvidia fell again after its CEO resigned, and Treasury yields rose. Most sectors outside tech finished higher, and the S&P 500 still gained 2.5% on the week, its first winning week since early October.
mood: Cautious, not panicked. Tech is under pressure, but the rest of the market held up and the week was still positive.
veqt: VEQT holds thousands of stocks across the US, Canada and international markets, so a tech-led dip moves it far less than the Nasdaq.
